sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In the coming year, GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic and Manjaro may become way more attainable for millions of Americans as President Trump promises to lower their cost and drug makers
sentences.zh: 在未来一年里，像Ozempic和Mounjaro这样的GLP-1药物可能会让数百万美国人更容易获得，因为特朗普总统承诺降低其成本，而制药商们

sentences.en: race to release them in pill form, paving the way for what could be the next revolution in weight loss.
sentences.zh: 正竞相推出药丸形式，为下一场减肥革命铺平道路。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Isha Nelson on how that story of accessibility actually started years
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事伊莎·尼尔森将讲述这个关于可及性的故事是如何在几年前

sentences.en: ago when one company invented the first version of these drugs and then lost control of them.
sentences.zh: 开始的，当时一家公司发明了这些药物的第一个版本，随后却失去了对它们的控制。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月14日，星期五。

sentences.en: Isha, you've been covering Ozempic and this new class of weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 伊莎，你一直在报道Ozempic和这类新型减肥药。

sentences.en: And we're coming to you because it seems as though we may be approaching a real turning point in our collective relationship to these medications.
sentences.zh: 我们找你是因为我们似乎正处于与这些药物集体关系的真正转折点。

sentences.en: So just tell me about how you're thinking about this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，请告诉我你是如何看待这个时刻的。

sentences.en: Yes, I think we are definitely at some sort of turning point or at least heading towards the next stage of these new class of weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为我们绝对处于某种转折点，或者至少正朝着这类新型减肥药的下一阶段迈进。

sentences.en: They've been available for a few years now, but despite there being 100 million Americans,
sentences.zh: 它们已经上市几年了，但尽管有1亿美国人

sentences.en: for example, who are classified as obese, only a few million people are using these drugs.
sentences.zh: 被归类为肥胖，却只有几百万人在使用这些药物。

sentences.en: So we are, I think, getting to this point where access will really broaden and many more people might start to use them.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我们正达到一个获取渠道将真正拓宽的节点，更多的人可能会开始使用它们。

sentences.en: And that's because one of the big changes we can expect is that these drugs will become available in pill form.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们可以预见的一个重大变化是，这些药物将以药丸形式出现。

sentences.en: Because at the moment, you can only use them as injections.
sentences.zh: 因为目前，你只能通过注射使用它们。

sentences.en: They're weekly injections that might deter some people.
sentences.zh: 它们是每周一次的注射，这可能会让一些人望而却步。

sentences.en: But I think these pills could really revolutionize the access to weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这些药丸真的可以彻底改变减肥药的获取方式。

sentences.en: And those pills should start to hit the market early next year.
sentences.zh: 这些药丸应该会在明年年初开始上市。

sentences.en: That's huge.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And the other thing that could widely increase access to many more Americans is the deal
sentences.zh: 另一件能让更多美国人广泛获得这些药物的事情，是

sentences.en: President Trump recently announced.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统最近宣布的协议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Tell me about that deal.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个协议。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So last week, President Trump got into the Oval Office, the heads of Novo Nordisk and the heads of Eli Lilly.
sentences.zh: 上周，特朗普总统在椭圆形办公室会见了诺和诺德和礼来的负责人。

sentences.en: Well, both of these gentlemen, they really are stars in the truest sense.
sentences.zh: 这两位先生，他们确实是名副其实的明星。

sentences.en: And it's an honor to have you in the White House.
sentences.zh: 很荣幸能请到你们来到白宫。

sentences.en: These are the two companies that are responsible for making the weight loss drugs that you probably know about.
sentences.zh: 这两家公司就是你们可能听说过的那些减肥药的制造商。

sentences.en: So Novo Nordisk is the maker behind Zempik and Wigofi.
sentences.zh: 诺和诺德是Ozempic和Wegovy背后的制造商。

sentences.en: And then you also have Eli Lilly.
sentences.zh: 然后还有礼来公司。

sentences.en: They make Monjaro and Zep Bound.
sentences.zh: 他们生产Mounjaro和Zepbound。

sentences.en: There's a lot of people in the room, I should say.
sentences.zh: 我得说，房间里有很多人。

sentences.en: Dr. Oz is there.
sentences.zh: 奥兹医生也在场。

sentences.en: RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 小肯尼迪

sentences.en: is there.
sentences.zh: 也在场。

sentences.en: Several other members of staff who have worked on these negotiations are there as well.
sentences.zh: 几位参与这些谈判的工作人员也在场。

sentences.en: And President Trump, you know, he calls this the fat drug.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统，你知道，他把这称为“减肥药”。

sentences.en: I call it the fat drug.
sentences.zh: 我称它为“减肥药”。

sentences.en: And he looks around the room and he starts asking.
sentences.zh: 他环顾房间，开始询问。

sentences.en: Do you take any of this stuff, Howard?
sentences.zh: 霍华德，你吃这东西吗？

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 还没。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: You know, who is taking this?
sentences.zh: 你知道，谁在吃这个？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: We have Steve.
sentences.zh: 我们有史蒂夫。

sentences.en: We're Steve.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫在哪？

sentences.en: Is she here?
sentences.zh: 她在这儿吗？

sentences.en: Head of Public Relations for the White House.
sentences.zh: 白宫公共关系主管。

sentences.en: He's taking it.
sentences.zh: 他在吃。

sentences.en: This is certainly one way to reduce the taboo of taking these drugs.
sentences.zh: 这无疑是消除服用这些药物禁忌的一种方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Just tell people who's on it.
sentences.zh: 直接告诉大家谁在用就行了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And President Trump got the heads of these companies into his office to announce that they were going to lower drug prices and massively increase access to these weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统把这些公司的负责人叫到办公室，宣布他们将降低药价，并大幅增加这些减肥药的获取渠道。

sentences.en: Significantly, Medicare and Medicaid will finally cover the cost of these weight loss drugs for millions of patients suffering from obesity.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，联邦医疗保险（Medicare）和医疗补助（Medicaid）最终将为数百万患有肥胖症的患者承担这些减肥药的费用。

sentences.en: So, up until now, you couldn't get these weight loss drugs through Medicare.
sentences.zh: 所以，在此之前，你无法通过联邦医疗保险获得这些减肥药。

sentences.en: So, you could get Ozempic, which is the drug that is marketed for diabetes, but Medicare prohibited access to drugs that are purely for weight loss.
sentences.zh: 你可以获得Ozempic，这是一种针对糖尿病销售的药物，但联邦医疗保险禁止获取纯粹用于减肥的药物。

sentences.en: And this deal will change that.
sentences.zh: 而这项协议将改变这一点。

sentences.en: President Trump is the friend of the forgotten American.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统是被遗忘的美国人的朋友。

sentences.en: Obesity is a disease of poverty, overwhelmingly.
sentences.zh: 肥胖症绝大多数是一种贫困疾病。

sentences.en: And these drugs have only been available for people who have wealth.
sentences.zh: 而这些药物此前只提供给有钱人。

sentences.en: RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 小肯尼迪

sentences.en: and Dr. Oz, they talk about President Trump being here for the forgotten man of America.
sentences.zh: 和奥兹医生，他们谈到特朗普总统是为了美国被遗忘的人民而来。

sentences.en: And we are democratizing access to these medications and dealing with a moral imperative to make sure that all Americans have access.
sentences.zh: 我们正在使这些药物的获取民主化，并处理确保所有美国人都能获得药物的道德责任。

sentences.en: And one of the things Dr. Oz says is that...
sentences.zh: 奥兹医生说的一件事是……

sentences.en: Mr. President, our estimate, based on the company numbers as well, is Americans will lose 135 billion pounds by the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，根据公司数据，我们的估计是，到中期选举时，美国人将减掉1350亿磅。

sentences.en: But I don't measure it in pounds.
sentences.zh: 但我不是按磅来衡量的。

sentences.en: I measure it in saved lives.
sentences.zh: 我是按挽救的生命来衡量的。

sentences.en: He expects Americans to be able to lose 135 billion pounds by the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 他预计到中期选举时，美国人将能减掉1350亿磅。

sentences.en: Now, I'm assuming that's a mistake.
sentences.zh: 现在，我假设那是个错误。

sentences.en: Because if it were billions, that means each American would have to lose 400 pounds by next year.
sentences.zh: 因为如果是1350亿，意味着每个美国人明年得减掉400磅。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That seems pretty difficult.
sentences.zh: 那看起来相当困难。

sentences.en: So I'm assuming he meant 135 million.
sentences.zh: 所以我假设他指的是1.35亿。

sentences.en: Which is still a lot.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个很大的数字。

sentences.en: And it sounds like for a couple of reasons at this point, pretty soon we could be seeing many more Americans gaining access to these drugs.
sentences.zh: 听起来由于种种原因，很快我们就能看到更多的美国人获得这些药物。

sentences.en: And that very much, right, is just the latest beat in what has been now a years-long story of these medications spreading really quickly and widely.
sentences.zh: 这确实是这些药物迅速广泛传播这一多年故事的最新篇章。

sentences.en: Like, we started out hearing about them being used for weight loss among A-listers.
sentences.zh: 就像我们最初听说它们被一线明星用于减肥一样。

sentences.en: It seemed like celebrities were the only ones who could get their hands on them just about.
sentences.zh: 看起来几乎只有名人才弄得到它们。

sentences.en: And now I know so many people on them.
sentences.zh: 而现在我知道很多人都在用。

sentences.en: Yeah, these drugs have become really popular and quite widely available to some people in a very small amount of time,
sentences.zh: 是的，这些药物在很短的时间内变得非常流行，并且对某些人来说相当容易获得，

sentences.en: which is probably why you're hearing so many people talk about it, why you know so many people taking these drugs.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是为什么你听到这么多人谈论它，为什么你认识这么多人正在服用这些药物的原因。

sentences.en: And to really understand this democratization that is starting to take place,
sentences.zh: 要真正理解这种正在发生的民主化，

sentences.en: you need to understand Novonordisk, which is the Danish company behind the drug that I've been covering.
sentences.zh: 你需要了解诺和诺德，也就是我一直在报道的这种药物背后的丹麦公司。

sentences.en: And to some extent, how they've managed and at times mismanaged the rollout of the drug.
sentences.zh: 以及在某种程度上，他们是如何管理，有时又是如何误导了这种药物的推广。

sentences.en: Because efforts to increase supply, efforts to increase access, have really been at the heart of this story the whole time.
sentences.zh: 因为增加供应、增加获取渠道的努力，始终是这个故事的核心。

sentences.en: So what is that story of how we got here?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是如何走到这一步的呢？

sentences.en: So Novonordisk is this company that has been around for 100 years and for almost all of that time has been doing one thing, which is diabetes treatments.
sentences.zh: 诺和诺德是一家已经存在100年的公司，在几乎所有的时间里，它只做一件事，那就是糖尿病治疗。

sentences.en: It has been making insulin.
sentences.zh: 它一直在生产胰岛素。

sentences.en: And to this day, it still makes about half of the world's insulin supply.
sentences.zh: 时至今日，它仍然生产着全球约一半的胰岛素供应。

sentences.en: But in the 1980s, GLP-1s are discovered.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪80年代，GLP-1被发现了。

sentences.en: And it's the hormone in your body that can help manage glucose levels.
sentences.zh: 它是你体内有助于控制血糖水平的激素。

sentences.en: And the problem that is had in trying to make GLP-1s into a medicine is that it's just really short acting.
sentences.zh: 而试图将GLP-1制成药物的问题在于，它的作用时间太短了。

sentences.en: You know, you put it into humans and it vanishes instantly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你把它注入人体，它瞬间就消失了。

sentences.en: So one of the things Novonordisk scientists and others, you know, this is not just happening in one place,
sentences.zh: 所以诺和诺德的科学家和其他人正在做的事情之一，你知道，这不仅仅发生在一个地方，

sentences.en: but one of the things they're trying to figure out is how to make it long lasting.
sentences.zh: 他们试图弄清楚的一件事是如何让它持久有效。

sentences.en: Eventually, they do come up with a way to make it last long enough so you can have a daily injection and you end up with this drug that becomes known as Victoza.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们确实找到了一种方法，使其持续时间足够长，这样你就可以进行每日注射，最终得到了这种被称为Victoza的药物。

sentences.en: Never heard of it.
sentences.zh: 没听说过。

sentences.en: But I'm honestly, I'm not surprised.
sentences.zh: 但我老实说，我并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Victoza, though it's discovered in 1997, doesn't hit the market till 2010.
sentences.zh: Victoza虽然在1997年被发现，但直到2010年才上市。

sentences.en: And even though they start to see the weightless effects of it, it is still only for diabetes.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们开始看到它的减肥效果，但它仍然只用于糖尿病。

sentences.en: Not until 2014 do they have the same drug, but for weight loss.
sentences.zh: 直到2014年，他们才拥有同样的药物，但用于减肥。

sentences.en: And that becomes Saxenda.
sentences.zh: 那变成了Saxenda。

sentences.en: Did you hear of that one?
sentences.zh: 你听说过那个吗？

sentences.en: No, but what a name.
sentences.zh: 没有，但这名字真绝。

sentences.en: I don't actually know how they come up with these names.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道他们是怎么想出这些名字的。

sentences.en: I would maybe love to find out.
sentences.zh: 我可能很想查清楚。

sentences.en: So you have this drug that is allowing people to lose weight, but it's moderate weight loss.
sentences.zh: 所以你有了这种能让人减肥的药物，但减肥效果适中。

sentences.en: You know, only about 5% of weight loss, which is probably why you don't hear much about it at the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，只有大约5%的体重减轻，这可能就是为什么你当时没怎么听说过它。

sentences.en: Now, the company is aware that it's on to something because this is pretty good weight loss.
sentences.zh: 现在，公司意识到它有所发现，因为这减肥效果相当不错。

sentences.en: And the other thing is it doesn't come with all these nasty side effects.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是它没有所有这些讨厌的副作用。

sentences.en: Back then, especially in the 90s, weight loss drugs have a bad reputation.
sentences.zh: 那时，特别是在90年代，减肥药名声很差。

sentences.en: This is a time when these drugs have all sorts of side effects.
sentences.zh: 那是一个这些药物有各种副作用的时代。

sentences.en: Sometimes they're pretty dangerous.
sentences.zh: 有时它们相当危险。

sentences.en: Sometimes they're not very effective.
sentences.zh: 有时它们效果不佳。

sentences.en: And also the culture is very different.
sentences.zh: 而且当时的文化也非常不同。

sentences.en: Obesity isn't considered a disease.
sentences.zh: 肥胖症不被视为一种疾病。

sentences.en: It is all about willpower, diet and exercise.
sentences.zh: 一切都取决于意志力、饮食和锻炼。

sentences.en: So people aren't thinking, how should you medically treat obesity?
sentences.zh: 所以人们并没有在想，应该如何从医学上治疗肥胖症？

sentences.en: But they do not give up on this.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有放弃。

sentences.en: And the team behind it do not give up on this.
sentences.zh: 背后的团队也没有放弃。

sentences.en: And they keep looking for a way to make these drugs last even longer.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在寻找让这些药物持续时间更长的方法。

sentences.en: And that's how we get to semiglutide, which you will know because that is Ozempic.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们得到司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）的方式，你会知道它，因为那就是Ozempic。

sentences.en: Finally, Ozempic.
sentences.zh: 终于，Ozempic。

sentences.en: We're here.
sentences.zh: 我们到了。

sentences.en: We're here at Ozempic.
sentences.zh: 我们到了Ozempic这里。

sentences.en: Ozempic is approved in the U.S.
sentences.zh: Ozempic于2017年在美国获得批准。
首先，它是每周一次的注射。

sentences.en: It's a weekly injection, for starters.
sentences.zh: 所以不再需要每日注射了。

sentences.en: So no more daily injections.
sentences.zh: 而且它还能带来更多的体重减轻，在临床试验中约为15%。

sentences.en: And it also leads to much more weight loss, about 15% in clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 所以这与第一代GLP-1药物相比有巨大的差异。

sentences.en: So it's a huge difference from this first generation of GLP-1 drugs.
sentences.zh: 所以这与第一代GLP-1药物相比有巨大的差异。

sentences.en: But I should say, at this time, Ozempic is supposed to be prescribed for diabetes and diabetes only.
sentences.zh: 但我得说，目前Ozempic（司美格鲁肽）应该只被用于治疗糖尿病，仅此而已。

sentences.en: But because it's leading to this big weight loss effect, you start to see doctors prescribing it off-label.
sentences.zh: 但因为它带来了显著的减重效果，你开始看到医生们在超适应症范围内开具处方。

sentences.en: Right, I remember this was when Ozempic suddenly exploded into our national consciousness.
sentences.zh: 没错，我记得就是在那时，Ozempic突然闯入了我们的国民意识。

sentences.en: It was like, at the Oscars, there were jokes about it.
sentences.zh: 就像在奥斯卡颁奖典礼上，都有关于它的笑话。

sentences.en: It seemed like it was everywhere, all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 它似乎突然间无处不在。

sentences.en: Oh, jokes about it.
sentences.zh: 哦，关于它的笑话。

sentences.en: When I look around this room, I can't help but wonder, is Ozempic right for me?
sentences.zh: 当我环顾这个房间时，我不禁想问，Ozempic适合我吗？

sentences.en: Endless queries about kind of which celebrity was taking it or not.

sentences.zh: 但这也会让你有很大的跌落空间。

sentences.en: But it also gives you a lot of room to fall.
sentences.zh: 正如很多事情一样，当它非常受欢迎，当它很好，当它有效，当你创造了一个市场时，你注定会遇到竞争。

sentences.en: And as with lots of things, when it's really popular, when it's good, when it works, and when you create a market, you are bound to get competition.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们所看到的。

sentences.en: And so that's what we're seeing.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这是自然的。

sentences.en: And in some ways, that is natural.
sentences.zh: 该公司知道它将开始面临竞争，而且它确实正在面临竞争。

sentences.en: The company knew that it was going to start to face competition, and it absolutely is.
sentences.zh: 对于其他人来说，你开始看到更多的获取机会。

sentences.en: For everyone else, you start to see much more access.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到更多的进入者进入市场，以及这些药物背后的科学原理、人们对它们的反应以及它们所采取的形式也会更加多样化。

sentences.en: We'll see more entrance into the market and more variety of actually the science behind these drugs and how people respond to them and the forms that they take as well.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到更多的进入者进入市场，以及这些药物背后的科学原理、人们对它们的反应以及它们所采取的形式也会更加多样化。

sentences.en: So not just injections, but also the pills, also the frequency that you'll be likely to take them for, the side effects that they might give you or not give you.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅是注射剂，还有药片，以及你可能需要服用的频率，还有它们可能会或不会给你带来的副作用。

sentences.en: So this is definitely the beginning of an expansion of access to these drugs, and it's hard to actually know where it stops.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是扩大这些药物获取渠道的开端，而且很难真正知道它会在哪里停止。

sentences.en: Isha, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 伊莎，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: I loved being here.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢来这里。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the government slowly reopened as the longest shutdown in history came to an end.
sentences.zh: 周四，随着史上最长停摆的结束，政府缓慢地重新开放了。

sentences.en: Agency workers returned to their offices, and federal courts resumed their normal dockets.
sentences.zh: 政府机构工作人员回到了办公室，联邦法院也恢复了正常的审理日程。

sentences.en: Government employees expect to see paychecks again as early as November 20th.
sentences.zh: 政府雇员预计最早在11月20日就能再次领到工资。

sentences.en: And in good news for travelers, ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday, disruptions to air traffic eased as federal officials canceled a plan to further expand restrictions
sentences.zh: 对于旅客来说，在感恩节假期前有一个好消息，随着联邦官员取消了一项进一步扩大限制的计划，空中交通的中断情况有所缓解，

sentences.en: on flights at 40 busy airports.
sentences.zh: 这些限制涉及40个繁忙机场的航班。

sentences.en: And Blue Origin, the company started by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, successfully launched its new Glenn rocket and landed the booster on a platform in the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 由亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯创办的蓝色起源公司成功发射了其新型格伦火箭，并将助推器降落在位于大西洋的一个平台上。

sentences.en: It was a major breakthrough as the company tries to rival Elon Musk's SpaceX.
sentences.zh: 这是该公司试图与埃隆·马斯克的SpaceX竞争过程中的一项重大突破。

sentences.en: SpaceX had landed a booster for the first time a decade ago, but no other company had pulled off the feet for an orbital-class rocket until Blue Origin.
sentences.zh: SpaceX在十年前首次成功回收了助推器，但在蓝色起源之前，还没有其他公司能为轨道级火箭实现这一壮举。

sentences.en: It was a major accomplishment for a company that's long been seen as sluggish and disappointing when compared with SpaceX, which now dominates the space industry.
sentences.zh: 对于一家长期以来与目前主导航天工业的SpaceX相比被视为行动迟缓且令人失望的公司来说，这是一项重大成就。

sentences.en: Blue Origin is also planning a large robotic moon landing next year.
sentences.zh: 蓝色起源还计划在明年进行一次大型机器人登月任务。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由

sentences.zh: 里基·诺韦茨基、

sentences.zh: 凯特琳·奥基夫和戴安娜·阮制作。

sentences.zh: 节目由丽莎·周剪辑，包含马里昂·洛萨诺和黛安·黄创作的音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利负责工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittrelleff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特雷夫。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
